claim: Rainforest World Music Festival 2026 runs 26-28 June at Sarawak Cultural Village, theme Regenerations: Roots & Rhythms.
quote: Rainforest World Music Festival 2026 | June 26-28, Sarawak ... held at the Living Museum - Sarawak Cultural Village, Kuching.

claim: Gawai Dayak is a Sarawak public holiday on 1-2 June celebrating the rice harvest.
quote: Gawai Dayak is a regional public holiday in the Malaysian state of Sarawak observed on June 1st and 2nd.

claim: Borneo Cultures Museum opened March 2022, is the largest in Malaysia, with four themed gallery floors.
quote: opened to the public on March 9, 2022 ... the largest museum in Malaysia and the second largest in Southeast Asia ... Love our Rivers, In Harmony with Nature, Time Changes, Objects of Desire.

claim: Kuching means cat in Malay and the city embraces felines as its symbol.
quote: Kuching in Malay means cat, and thus Sarawak's state capital is known as the City of Cats.

claim: Chinese New Year 2026 falls 17 Feb; Kuching celebrates with a Carpenter Street procession and fireworks over the river.
quote: Chinese New Year 2026 falls on February 17 (Year of the Horse) ... cultural shows at Carpenter Street ... and a fireworks display over the Sarawak River.

claim: Kuching's festival calendar includes Chap Goh Meh (~3 Mar), Mid-Autumn (Sep), Sarawak Regatta (Oct/Nov) and a Christmas parade in early December.
quote: Chap Goh Meh - February/March (March 3, 2026) ... Kuching City Christmas Parade - December (1st week).

claim: The Hong San Si temple procession draws over 10,000 participants through Kuching's streets.
quote: More than 10,000 participants are expected to take part in the Hong San Si temple celebration.

claim: Gawai Dayak is a month-long harvest-festival season from late May to end of June featuring traditional dress, dance and open houses.
quote: Gawai Dayak is a month-long festival season that starts from the end of May until the end of June every year.

claim: RWMF 2026 features over 200 performers from 12 countries and 50+ workshops; ranked a global top-10 festival.
quote: over 200 performers from 12 countries, and over 50 workshops, cultural demonstrations, and intimate mini sessions ... ranked No. 8 in the Top 10 Festivals globally.

claim: RWMF 2026 early-bird tickets are RM235 (day) and RM635 (3-day).
quote: Early Bird one-day passes are priced at RM235 and three-day passes at RM635, available until 31 March 2026.

claim: The Kuching Festival food fair 2026 runs 22 July to 16 August (26 nights).
quote: Kuching Festival Food Fair 2026 to run July 22-Aug 16.

claim: The 2026 Kuching Festival food fair adds representatives from 65 UNESCO Cities of Gastronomy.
quote: Representatives from 65 UNESCO Cities of Gastronomy, spanning over 30 countries, are expected to visit during the festival.

claim: Kuching's Mid-Autumn festival on Carpenter Street has 50+ stalls and is now a multi-ethnic people's celebration.
quote: The festival features more than 50 stalls offering both halal and non-halal food along a single street route.

claim: Mid-Autumn Festival 2026 falls on 25 September.
quote: Mid-Autumn Festival 2026, 2027 and 2028 ... In 2026, the Mid-Autumn Festival falls on Friday, September 25.

claim: The Sarawak Regatta is an annual Oct-Nov longboat race on the Sarawak River at the Kuching Waterfront with the Raja Sungai title.
quote: The highlight is the fierce battle for the prestigious 'Raja Sungai' (King of the River) title in the 30-paddler bidar longboat race.

claim: The Sarawak Regatta originated in 1872 to replace tribal conflict with friendly competition.
quote: Originating in 1872 during the James Brooke era to replace tribal conflicts with friendly competition.

claim: Most major Sarawak festivals fall May-October; the What About Kuching (WAK) arts festival runs in October.
quote: What About Kuching (WAK) Festival - October every year across multiple Kuching venues.

claim: Borneo Cultures Museum opens Mon-Fri 9:00-16:45 and weekends/holidays 9:30-16:30.
quote: open Monday to Friday from 9:00 AM to 4:45 PM, and Saturday, Sunday, and Public Holidays from 9:30 AM to 4:30 PM.

claim: Borneo Cultures Museum foreign-adult admission is RM50 (RM20 child).
quote: For foreign adults, the admission price is RM 50.00, while children under 12 are charged RM 20.00.

claim: Borneo Cultures Museum began charging admission; other state museums in the cluster remain free.
quote: Borneo Cultures Museum to charge visitors starting Aug 1.

claim: The Cat Museum opened 1993 with 4 galleries and over 4,000 artefacts including a mummified Egyptian cat and the rare Bay cat.
quote: Over 4,000 artefacts ... A mummified cat from ancient Egypt ... the Bay cat (Felis badia), described as the world's rarest cat.

claim: The Cat Museum in Petra Jaya is free (camera fee applies) and open 9:00-16:30 daily.
quote: located at Bangunan DBKU, Jalan Semariang, Petra Jaya ... operates from 09:00-16:30 ... Entrance is free, however visitors planning to take photos ... are charged.

claim: The Textile Museum opened in 2005, is free, and opens 9:00-16:30 daily.
quote: The Textile Museum was opened to the public in 2005 ... Operation hours are 9am to 4:30pm, Monday to Sunday with free entrance.

claim: The Chinese History Museum is a free museum on the Kuching Waterfront in a 1912 building.
quote: a free, educational museum on the Kuching waterfront ... The building was built in 1912.

claim: The Chinese History Museum exhibits early migration, trade routes and community associations of Sarawak's Chinese.
quote: Exhibits include the early trade routes, initial migration from various regions of China ... the formation of trade and community associations.

claim: Fort Margherita, built 1879 by Rajah Charles Brooke, houses the Brooke Gallery and sits across the river near The Astana.
quote: a fort constructed in 1879 by Charles Brooke ... now houses the Brooke Gallery ... situated across the Sarawak River near The Astana.

claim: Fort Margherita entry is RM30 adult / RM15 child; reachable by RM1 tambang boat across the river.
quote: Entry fees are RM30 per adult and RM15 per child ... a tambang boat from the Waterfront Promenade ... The boat ride costs about RM 1 per person.

claim: The Brooke Gallery at Fort Margherita tells the history of Sarawak's White Rajahs; the fort reopened in 2014 after restoration.
quote: Built by the second Rajah, Sir Charles Brooke, in 1879 ... It reopened to the public in 2014 after a 14-month restoration.

claim: The Ranee Museum (RM20 global / RM10 local, open 9:00-16:45 daily) is dedicated to Margaret Brooke, first Ranee of Sarawak.
quote: admission prices: Local: RM 10, Global: RM 20 ... dedicated to the life, legend and legacy of Margaret de Windt.

claim: The Old Court House (built 1874) now houses the Ranee Museum plus cafés, restaurants and a bar.
quote: originally built in 1874 ... home to a mix of cafes, restaurants, a bar, and the Ranee Museum.

claim: The old Sarawak Museum's reopening has faced repeated delays during restoration and gallery installation.
quote: Tourism Minister hopes old Sarawak Museum will reopen this year after extensive restoration, delays.

claim: The 1888 old Sarawak Museum is only partially open via small timed Special Tours limited to 15 walk-in visitors.
quote: open as part of daily Special Tours split into two sessions at 10.30am-11.30am and 2.30pm-3.30pm, with each session limited to only 15 visitors.

claim: Sarawak Cultural Village runs a 45-minute multi-ethnic dance show at 11:30 and 16:00 daily; open 9:00-17:00.
quote: morning show at 11:30 am and afternoon show at 4:00 pm ... 45 minute cultural performance ... The village is open daily from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

claim: Sarawak Cultural Village entry is about RM135 for non-Malaysian adults / RM90 for Malaysians.
quote: For Malaysian adults, the entrance fee is RM90.00, while non-Malaysian adults pay RM135.00.

claim: Annah Rais is a living Bidayuh longhouse ~60 km (90 min) from Kuching with bamboo architecture and welcome tuak.
quote: about 60 km from Kuching city, with a scenic 90-minute drive ... Visitors are welcomed with traditional tuak, explore the longhouse's bamboo-crafted architecture.

claim: Annah Rais longhouse has stood 200+ years, home to 80+ families, with a baruk headhouse holding an old skull collection.
quote: stood for over 200 years ... home to more than 80 families ... the Baruk, a fortress ... contains a fireplace surrounded by the tribe's notorious collection of human skulls.

claim: Medan Niaga Satok is Kuching's biggest wet/fresh-produce market, beside the Sarawak River near the Satok bridge.
quote: the biggest wet market in Kuching City by land size area ... located beside the Sarawak river, nearby the Satok Suspension bridge.

claim: Satok market is busiest Saturday from ~16:00 and Sunday from ~07:00.
quote: It gets really busy as early as 7am on Sunday morning ... expect more goods/vendors after 4pm on Saturday.

claim: Main Bazaar is a row of shophouses by the Waterfront selling souvenirs and traditional crafts, closing around 5pm.
quote: a row of two-storey shophouses ... the place to come if you are looking for souvenirs or traditional arts and crafts ... Main Bazaar closes around 5 PM.

claim: India Street is a pedestrian mall lined with shops, particularly textiles.
quote: India Street is lined with shops selling all kinds of goods, particularly textiles.

claim: The Tun Jugah Foundation (Level 4, Tun Jugah Tower) displays Iban pua kumbu and runs weaving classes; open Mon-Fri 9:00-16:30.
quote: the classes are also open to anyone interested in learning to weave the Pua Kumbu ... Opening hours are 9.00am - 12:00 noon, 1:00pm - 4:30pm (Monday to Friday).

claim: Pua kumbu is an Iban ceremonial textile made with ikat dyeing and a backstrap loom using Borneo jungle fibres and dyes.
quote: made using a combination of ikat dyeing and backstrap loom weaving, using fibres and dyes endemic to the jungles of Borneo.

claim: Kuching craft workshops cover pua kumbu, beadwork, basketry, pottery and wood carving, with beginner sessions of 1-2 hours up to a half-day.
quote: shorter introductory sessions lasting 1-2 hours, while more in-depth experiences ... can extend to half a day.

claim: Kuching batik workshops (e.g. Within Arts Reach) teach sketching motifs, using the canting tool and dyeing your own piece.
quote: participants learn to sketch original motifs, handle canting tools, apply basic colour theory, and work with dyes to complete their own batik pieces.

claim: A dedicated Sarawak Craft Centre near the Borneo Cultures Museum is set to break ground in 2026 with a ~2-year build.
quote: Construction of the Sarawak Craft Centre on a two-acre site near to the Borneo Cultures Museum is expected to begin in 2026 and take about two years.

claim: Iban pottery is a traditional Sarawak craft now in decline.
quote: Sarawak Crafts: The Dying Art of Iban Pottery.

claim: National Geographic profiles the craftspeople of Sarawak and their traditions.
quote: Legends of Kuching: in conversation with the craftspeople of Sarawak.

claim: The 2.5m Great Cat statue at Padungan roundabout was unveiled when Kuching gained city status on 1 Aug 1988 and is dressed for each festival.
quote: Kuching officially became Kuching City and the Cat City ... on 1st August 1988 ... dressed up in traditional attire during major festivals - red during Chinese New Year ... a traditional Iban vest during the local harvest festival.

claim: Padungan marked its centennial in 2026 with seven heritage murals by Sarawakian artist Leonard Siaw depicting vintage trades.
quote: Padungan Street marks its centennial with the unveiling of seven heritage murals ... created by Sarawakian artist Leonard Siaw, depict vintage trades, community life, and traditions.

claim: Kuching's councils are linking murals into a continuous walkable heritage trail from Padungan to India Street.
quote: a continuous Cultural Heritage Mural Walk stretching from Padungan to India Street, linking existing urban murals into a walkable and immersive historical corridor.

claim: Tua Pek Kong is Kuching's oldest Chinese temple, believed to predate 1839, and survived the 1884 fire and WWII.
quote: the oldest temple in the city ... believed to have been in existence before 1839 ... survived the 1884 Great Fire of Kuching.

claim: Carpenter Street is the heart of Kuching's Chinatown and hosts cultural shows during festivals.
quote: cultural shows at Carpenter Street (the heart of Kuching's Chinatown).
